description: Schema-only #768 slice stacked on canonical API #808. Introduce a separate Engine-owned execution record for the Person-bound request, finalization capability hash, private trace/tool-result descriptors, usage and outcome with references to canonical user/public answer message UUIDs; no private execution fields are included in shared-history projections. Test-first DB FK/check/uniqueness validation, linkage without duplicating a public answer, nil Person rejection, legacy Message/rating/trace preservation, and guarded non-destructive rollback. No copying/backfill of existing traces or browser/agent exposure: zaq-emb.15 owns legacy migration/cutover, downstream routing owns actual execution writes. Action reuse: extend Conversations/Message schema associations and existing finalize_incoming contract, local-only persistence schema, not new agent Action. Read Engine/Agent guides (Agent if touching lib/zaq/agent), docs/action-reuse.md, testing handbook and documentation policy. No new-feature E2E before human UX approval.
